entities.summary: South Norway is the southern and by far most populous half of Norway, consisting of the regions of Western Norway, Eastern Norway, Southern Norway (Agder) and Trøndelag. In English, South Norway was historically also known as Norway Proper, a term that often has a broader meaning in contemporary usage.
